verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so shared team inboxes are a fair question for it. The evidence documents no shared accounts, team channels, or synchronized conversation state across team members. The 'Unified Inbox' lets a single user connect multiple providers, which is an adjacent feature and not team collaboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
